aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable evidence but misgroups the Test/Normal comparisons and cites incomplete outcome rows.
issues: Changed factor label is malformed and mixes Test with an unexplained '2'.
1st-round Normal row is reused as control for 2nd and 3rd rounds.
Outcome comparison omits paired Normal rows for 2nd and 3rd rounds.
Metric should be NG damage FS or NG rate, not Result TEST.
9.6 and 9.8 appear to be context or unpaired trials, not direct Normal/Test pairs.
correctionPlan: Define changed factor as improved Test jig versus Normal, with round/cutting settings as subgroups.
Pair 1st Test with 1st Normal, 2nd Test with 2nd Normal, and 3rd Test with 3rd Normal.
Use rows 9.9!20-9.9!25 as the main comparative outcome evidence.
Set outcome metric to NG damage FS rate and keep input/NG counts as support.
Treat 9.6 and 9.8 as purpose/preliminary context unless full paired rows prove comparability.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are citeable but not yet sufficient because key paired rows are omitted or misused.
